exposure: Extremely advanced maternal age (> or = 45 years)
extremely advanced maternal age (> or = 45 years)
cohort: Women with singleton delivery and beyond 24 weeks of gestation
finding: Women aged 45 or more experienced increased maternal and neonatal adverse outcomes compared to younger women.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly more common among women aged 45 or older compared to younger women (OR = 4.18; 95% CI = 2.52-6.93).
